description: actionConfig.residualize — tunable knobs default to None (config-not-code).

chromosomes.description: Chromosome allow-list; default from the study project chromosomes.
chromosomes.title: Chromosomes

composition_columns.description: Leukocyte Ω columns to encode as Neu-referenced ALR. Omit to skip Ω residualization.
composition_columns.title: Composition Columns

composition_pseudocount.description: ALR zero-replacement pseudocount. Operator-set per procedure/profile.
composition_pseudocount.title: Composition Pseudocount

composition_reference.description: ALR reference leaf (typically Neu). Operator-set per procedure.
composition_reference.title: Composition Reference

contexts.description: Methylation contexts to residualize. Operator-set; typically [CG].
contexts.title: Contexts

covariates_path.description: CSV paths joined on sample_id (cell_fractions plus confounder_scores). Operator-set per procedure/profile.
covariates_path.title: Covariates Path

m_value_eps.description: Clip beta to [eps, 1-eps] before logit / after inverse logit.
m_value_eps.title: M Value Eps

min_coverage.description: Minimum mC+uC for a CpG to enter the M-value matrix.
min_coverage.title: Min Coverage

numeric_columns.description: Non-composition covariate columns (smoking_score, age_score, bmi_score, crp_score, …).
numeric_columns.title: Numeric Columns

sample_id_column.description: Covariate CSV sample-id column name. Operator-set; typically sample_id.
sample_id_column.title: Sample Id Column

variance_threshold.description: Drop covariates with sample std below this (constant never-smokers, etc.).
variance_threshold.title: Variance Threshold

title: ResidualizeStepConfig
